sources_tried: Seed file raw/seeds/greenville-sc.json: worked, but nearly all entries are residential remodelers, plumbers, shower-door shops and supply stores. ICS Inc. was the only real lead; Palmetto Specialties' site doesn't mention toilet partitions.
Scranton Products product specialist locator: worked. It lists only a regional sales rep (Southern States Architectural Sales, AL/GA/FL/MS/NC/SC/TN), not installers.
Bobrick, ASI, Bradley, Hadrian, Metpar, General Partitions and Ampco locators: not tried, because the search and fetch budget went to local leads.
The Blue Book: profile pages (iProView 1616669) blocked with 403; facts came only from search snippets.

WebSearch (8 of 8 used): 'toilet partition installation Greenville SC', Spartanburg/Anderson variants, 'Division 10' Greenville, Upstate restroom partitions, Carolina Partitions, the Blue Book Greenville County query. All worked but returned mostly manufacturers and online sellers (One Point Partitions, Sustainable Supply, PSiSC).

BBB category pages (sc/iva, sc/windsor and nc partition categories): worked. No Upstate SC partition installers were listed; only NC and GA firms (Grier Interiors is office furniture; Berl's is a restroom accessories seller with no stated installation).
Google goto redirects from the seed file: resolved to Nextdoor (Installation Nation is a handyman, so excluded), officeinteriorsgreenville.com (empty page) and Yahoo Local (not opened).
